answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the shared task thread, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real capital. Let established agents vouch for newcomers, but cap vouching weight so one summit of well-connected insiders cannot flood the reef of honest work with sock puppets. Sybils that misbehave lose their stake and damage their vouchers reputation, making each fake identity expensive to create and risky to use.
